components.css: .ds-check{font:400 1rem/1.8 Plex,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--text,#cfcfcb);border-block:1px solid var(--rule,#303030)}.ds-check summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;padding:23px 0;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease-out}.ds-check summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-check summary>span{font-size:1.14rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink,#fff)}.ds-check summary:hover{background:var(--surface,#0c0c0c)}.ds-check svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--sand,#cbb896);transition:transform .2s ease-out}.ds-check[open] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}.ds-check p{font-size:.9rem;margin:0;padding-bottom:25px}.ds-check p span{color:var(--olive,#7fae8d);font-size:.84rem}.ds-check summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive,#7fae8d);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
A bilingual editorial register, extending the owner’s Nawafith reference through black surfaces, fine rules, serif headings and readable sans serif guidance. Dense information stays calm through clear columns, measured paragraphs and visible completion criteria.

The custom reading preview and the repository presentation share content and artwork. GitHub controls its own typography and layout; its local approximation is not the custom reading system. Both remain local and unpublished. This document records the implemented system in `site/preview.css`, `site/preview.js` and `scripts/build_preview.py`.
keyCharacteristics: Black reading surface with sand actions and olive verification cues.
Newsreader Latin headings, Amiri Arabic headings and Plex body text.
Fine ruled registers, native disclosures and square controls.
English first, paired Arabic pages and logical RTL spacing.

rules.name: The Ruled Register Rule
rules.body: Separate repeated checks and guide links with fine rules and open space. Reserve the filled surface for bounded text such as the copyable prompt.

rules.name: The Two Scripts Rule
rules.body: Use the appropriate display face for each script, preserve Arabic shaping and apply no Arabic tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Use borders, tone and spacing for hierarchy. The custom reading surface uses no shadows.

dos: Do use logical inline spacing and paired language links.
Do keep finish criteria visible inside each expanded check.
Do retain keyboard focus, native disclosure behavior and a manual copy fallback.
Do keep font licenses and artwork provenance with redistributed assets.
Do treat GitHub previews as approximate and publication as a separate approval.
donts: Don't apply Latin letter spacing to Arabic.
Don't replace ruled reading registers with decorative card grids.
Don't imply that the guide scans a device or automatically changes settings.
Don't put private audit data or identifying material in public assets or documentation.
Don't use the GitHub approximation’s system display font as the custom reading identity.
